text: वध का आदेश था। श्रीराम ने एक को छोड़ा।
hook_to_payoff: closes at the verse card, scene 8 (about 65–67%); payoff scenes 9–10 end by 84–88%
reasoning: Selected: highest rubric total. Pays off the Ep06 teaser verse 1.29.23 ('here you must kill them') in the first second, then reverses it: of all the attackers, one is not killed (1.30.18–20; all the rest die, 1.30.22–24). Frame 0 (Rama from behind, a shadow rakshasa hurled toward the ocean) reads muted. The main loop ('why or how one was spared?') closes at the verse card 1.30.20 and the payoff (Subahu, the rest, the completed sacrifice) ends by 84–88%. 'Spared' is reported, not a motive: the text says only that the Manava stunned him and did not take his life; 1.30.16 adds Rama's 'I am not eager to kill such ones'. Spoken about 2.6–2.8 s, as asked after the Ep06 speaker-check lesson (very short en hooks under Kokoro scored under 0.70).

text: यज्ञ की वेदी पर रक्त बरसा।
reasoning: 1.30.12–13 (streams of blood on the altar). Strong and true, but a frame 0 of blood rain sits badly with the 'gore off-screen' rule and it does not open the main loop (Maricha spared).

text: एक बाण, सौ योजन, सीधा समुद्र में।
hook_to_payoff: closes at scene 7 (about 55%), spends the Turn early
reasoning: 1.30.18 (a full hundred yojanas, into the ocean). Concrete, but 'yojana' needs explaining and it spends the Turn in the first second.

text: श्रीराम ने मारीच को क्यों छोड़ा?
hook_to_payoff: not closed by the text: Valmiki gives no motive
reasoning: Invites a motive the verses never state. The valmikiramayan.net commentary links it to the golden deer of the Aranya Kanda, but that is commentary, not Valmiki. Rejected on accuracy.

text: श्रीराम के अस्त्र ने राक्षस को समुद्र में फेंक दिया।
reasoning: 1.30.17–18. True, but a summary rather than a gap, and it is long to say.

text: छह रातें बिना नींद। फिर आकाश गरजा।
reasoning: 1.30.5 and 1.30.10. Atmospheric but slow, and it hides the episode's real twist.
